description: Zoho provides a large suite of business software products, including CRM, collaboration, finance, and project management tools. The public developer pages found here center on Zoho CRM integrations and Zoho-wide OAuth 2.0 authentication.
summary: zoho.com exposes a documented Zoho CRM REST API plus CRM GraphQL and MCP pages, but the available public pages did not reveal machine-readable spec URLs, GraphQL endpoint details, or MCP connect/auth details.
